# skycloak_client_theme_assignment (Resource)

Per-client login-theme override. Overrides the realm default for a single OIDC/SAML client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_client_theme_assignment" "web" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  client_id  = skycloak_application.web.client_id

  # Override just this client's login theme; omit to use the realm default.
  login = local.corporate_theme
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OIDC/SAML client ID. Immutable.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `login` (String) Custom theme ID to activate for this client's login page. Omit to use the realm default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/realm_name/client_id/theme`.
